message.content:
To terminate Visual Studio Code from the command line (Windows), you can use **`taskkill`**:

```cmd
taskkill /IM code.exe /F
```

Explanation:
- `/IM code.exe` – specifies the image name (`code.exe`) of the process(es) to target.
- `/F` – forces termination (equivalent to “force quit”).

This command will immediately close all running instances of VS Code. If you only want to kill a specific instance, you’ll need its PID and can use:

```cmd
taskkill /PID <pid> /F
```

Replace `<pid>` with the actual Process ID obtained from Task Manager or `tasklist`.
